newsitem.title: CANADA: Royal Bank moves finance dept to Toronto.
newsitem.headline: Royal Bank moves finance dept to Toronto.

text.p: The Royal Bank of Canada said on Tuesday it will move its finance department to Toronto from its head office in Montreal.
Canada's biggest bank said the move is in conjunction with the appointment of its new chief financial officer, Peter Currie, who is based in Toronto and replaces Montreal-based Emile Bolduc.
"That was announced to the employees yesterday as part of the announcement of the new CFO," said Royal Bank spokesman Langevin Cote.

All the employees, which include accountants and tax specialists, have been offered the chance to relocate to the Ontario capital. The department's clients are the bank's own business units, which are all based in Toronto.
He said the bank's corporate headquarters will remain in Montreal, but much of its business is centered in Toronto.
"There has been a general gravitation towards Toronto reflecting what's been happening to business generally in the country."
